parsed.body:
All [intruder] in each [corridorEW] move.
Then, all [intruder] in every Room move.

Each [character] in a Room with [intruder] or adjacent
to a Corridor with [intruder]:
Loses 1 [oxygenToken] or spends [ammoToken].

Resolve each [ICON: yellow triangular badge with black radiating chevron glyph] in
Unexplored Corridors.
confidentlyVisible: The face has a white PANIC title above dark science-fiction artwork.

A yellow canister glyph and a red ammunition-magazine glyph appear in the second rules panel.
No type line, footer label, upper-right icon, or lower-center bare icon is visible.
uncertainties: The final yellow triangular badge with a black radiating chevron-like glyph is not confidently distinguishable from the glossary's noise-related symbols or an unlisted card-local glyph, so it is transcribed literally rather than assigned a canonical identifier.
